column1: email

Hi there,

My son’s school project uses your SolarSift battery monitor, and the app won’t sync past 40% on his older iPad. Could you send a quick fix or tell me if we need a different model? Thanks.

Zdravo,

pišem vam, ker sem popolnoma zmeden glede vašega oglasa za "vodjo kreativnih navdihov" – ali je to sploh delovno mesto ali gre za plačano prakso? Na vaši spletni strani piše, da iščete nekoga s "praktičnim znanjem v retro-futurizmu", pa tudi na LinkedInu imate isto objavo, ampak s poudarkom na "upcycling starih disket".

Ali lahko prosim razložite, ali kandidat res potrebuje lastno žago za krožne plošče, ker sem včeraj prebral v nekem članku, da vičarji pri vas uporabljajo samo 3D-tiskalnike? In še to – zakaj v oglasu piše, da je "prioriteta poznavanje slovenskega ljudskega izročila", če pa so vsi projekti v angleščini?

Hvala za vsakršno pojasnilo, ker sem že trikrat poslal prošnjo, pa so mi vsakič odgovorili z drugačnim naslovom delovnega mesta.

Spoštovani organizatorji,  

zanimam se za udeležbo na vaši konferenci o trajnostnem turizmu, ki bo potekala maja v Ljubljani, in bi vas prosil, če mi lahko sporočite, ali obstaja študentska cena vstopnice ter ali je še kakšno prosto mesto za delavnico o digitalnem trženju.  

Hvala za vaš čas in lep pozdrav,  
Miha Kovač

Hey, sorry to bother you, but my daughter Emma is in her first year of your engineering program and shes been super stressed about choosing her electives for next semester. We tried to look up the course reqs on your website but the page was kinda confusing and kept timing out, and shes scared shes gonna miss the deadline. Could you maybe just tell us if the robotics course is open to first years or if she needs to take the intro mechanical class first? Also, shes really homesick and was wondering if theres any way she could get a room change to be closer to her friend from high school—not sure if thats even a thing but thought id ask. Thanks so much, we really appreciate any help.

Hello there,

I’m writing to you out of the blue because I stumbled across your team’s open-source command-line tool for batch-renaming photography files, and it has genuinely saved me hours of tedious work this week—thank you for making it freely available. I’m not a developer, just a history teacher who digitizes old family archives, so I don’t have a GitHub account or know how to file a proper issue. If there’s any chance you accept small, unsolicited donations via PayPal or a coffee fund, I’d love to send a modest token of appreciation so you can keep doing what you do.  

All the best and keep up the great work,  
A grateful stranger from Ohio

Hey, saw your lab's paper on quantum dots and thought you guys might wanna partner with us on a cool side project, we got a client who needs some nanosensors for, uh, environmental monitoring stuff, and we can pay upfront in crypto, just shoot me a email back if you're down, we're super flexible on deadlines and don't need any of that boring paperwork.

Spoštovani,

pred dvema dnevoma ste mi poslali sporočilo za javnost o »revolucionarnem preboju« v raziskavah kvantnega vračanja časa, vendar v prilogi ni bilo nobene študije, ampak le povezava do YouTube posnetka, kjer profesor v ozadju igra na harmoniko. Zdaj me kliče urednik in sprašuje, ali naj to objavimo kot znanost ali kot satiro, jaz pa sem že trikrat prebral vaš dopis in še vedno ne vem, ali je bil naslov »Čas je zgolj iluzija, dokazano v laboratoriju« mišljen dobesedno ali kot šala ob prvem aprilu. Ali lahko prosim dobim vsaj PDF, številko revije in ime recenzentov, da bom vedel, komu naj se zahvalim za ta »preboj« – ali pa se opravičim, če sem kaj spregledal? Hvala za razumevanje, ker sem očitno edini, ki mu ta stvar ni jasna.

hey guys, just wanted to let you know i finally got that weird printer on the second floor to work—turns out it was the network switch, not the driver, so i swapped it out with the spare we had. also, i ran a quick scan on the server and there’s a ton of old temp files eating up space, so i cleared those out but you might wanna check the backup drive cause it’s almost full again. lemme know if you want me to set up that auto-clean script i mentioned last time, i can do it on friday after lunch. sorry for the late email, my phone died and my laptop was being slow as hell. thanks!

Hey, quick heads-up — the analytics dashboard we pushed to staging is showing a 40% jump in session duration that doesn’t match our GA data. I think the custom event timer is firing twice on page load. Can you take a look before Thursday’s demo?

To whom it may concern:  

I’m following up on the third (yes, third) service request for the -80°C freezer in Room 214, because the alarm has been chirping since Tuesday and somehow the log says “resolved” twice without anyone actually checking the compressor. The temperature is holding at -72, which means your thawing samples are already halfway to a biology lesson in degradation, and I’m not the one who has to explain that to your PI. I need a clear sign-off from someone who actually opened the panel, not just a remote reboot, before I close this ticket again—my time is not a placeholder for your lab’s internal approval chain. Also, the spare fuse you ordered last month is still sitting in receiving, so if you want me to fix this before Friday’s run, send a human down with the part and a working keycard.

To whom it may concern, I am writing to you because I have been a loyal customer for three years and I genuinely cannot wrap my head around how you managed to ship me a “charcoal grey” merino sweater that is unmistakably, undeniably a deep forest green, unless you have all suddenly become colorblind over there, which honestly would explain a lot. I spent forty-five minutes on your website comparing the swatch to my monitor, and then I even asked my neighbor, who is an actual interior designer with a Pantone book, and she laughed out loud before confirming it’s green, so this is not a subjective thing. And to make matters worse, your returns portal kept crashing every time I tried to initiate a swap, and when I finally got through, the chatbot told me I’d have to pay for return shipping myself because the “color mismatch” wasn’t listed as a valid reason, which is like being fined for breathing your own air. I then waited on hold for twenty-two minutes, only to have the representative politely suggest I “try a different lighting in the room,” which is not only condescending but scientifically incorrect because no amount of halogen light is going to turn moss into charcoal. I am not even asking for a refund anymore—I just want you to take this sweater back and donate it to a forestry charity or something, but I refuse to spend another cent on your “convenient” return label, so please tell me what you are going to do to fix this mess without making me pay for your manufacturing mistake.

Zdravo, samo da se oglasim glede tiste tiskalniške kartuše v sobi 12 – vem, da smo že govorili, ampak danes sem jo čisto do konca razstavil in ugotovil, da ni samo zamašena šoba, ampak je tudi tista plastična zatičnica na drsniku počena, kar pomeni, da bi bila menjava samo črnila brez veze, ker bo tiskalo še naprej packalo po robovih, tako da bi jaz predlagal, da raje kar naročite nov komplet valjev, pa še tisti papir za nalepke, ki ste ga omenili prejšnji teden, je menda v drugem skladišču, ampak bom že jutri poskusil priti mimo, če bo gospod z dvorišča doma, da pogledam, če imajo kakšen rezervni del.

Hey, so I know we’ve been circling the whole data-migration thing for a while now, and I keep meaning to sit down and actually map out every table that’s living in the old warehouse versus the new one, but then every time I open the spreadsheet I get pulled into this other rabbit hole about our API rate limits, which honestly feels like trying to untangle a knot of Christmas lights while the dog is barking, and I think the real issue is that we never agreed on whether we’re keeping the legacy user IDs or just letting everything re-key itself, so maybe just give me a quick heads-up on that before I accidentally delete half the customer history on Thursday afternoon.

Spoštovani raziskovalci,  

pišem vam v imenu podjetja BioNova Labs, ki se ukvarja s komercializacijo naprednih biotehnoloških rešitev za kmetijstvo. Opazili smo vaše odmevne objave na področju mikrobioloških gnojil in verjamemo, da bi partnerstvo z nami vašim raziskavam omogočilo dostop do edinstvene zbirke talnih izolatov ter hitrejše patentne zaščite. V priponki vam pošiljam kratek povzetek naših zmogljivosti, ki je strogo zaupen, zato vas vljudno prosim, da ga pred ogledom prenesete na svoj osebni disk prek povezave, ki sem jo priložil. Brezplačna brezpogojna donacija v višini 5.000 evrov za vaš laboratorij je na voljo ob povratni potrditvi interesa, pri čemer potrebujemo le vaš podpis na priloženi pogodbi in bančne podatke za nakazilo. Hvala za vaš čas in upam na ugoden odziv ter uspešno sodelovanje.  

Lep pozdrav,  
Jan Kovač, predstavnik za raziskovalno sodelovanje

I’m writing because your “internship experience” is honestly a bait-and-switch—your job posting promised hands-on work with your actual product, but three weeks in, I’ve only been formatting spreadsheets and fetching coffee for your lead dev. I also noticed you still haven’t paid the stipend you outlined in the offer letter, and my bank account doesn’t care about your “startup cash-flow hiccup.” I need either the real projects you advertised or a clear date for full payment, because this is wasting my semester and your time. If that’s not possible, I’ll be documenting this for my university’s co-op office and moving on.

Dear Dr. Whitfield,  

I am writing to inquire whether your lab is currently accepting a postdoctoral researcher with expertise in high-throughput CRISPR screens and integrative genomics, as I believe my background in developing predictive models for drug resistance in glioblastoma could complement your ongoing work on tumor evolution. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss potential synergies and would welcome the chance to share my recent preprint on chromatin accessibility dynamics during therapy escape.

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to inquire whether your store would consider a wholesale partnership with our startup, GreenLoop, which produces compostable mailer bags made from industrial hemp, as we believe they would align perfectly with your commitment to plastic-free packaging. We are prepared to offer a forty percent margin on a six-month pilot order of five hundred units, shipped at our cost, to demonstrate their durability and customer appeal.

Hi Dr. Chen,

After three weeks of running that Western blot protocol you approved, I’ve triple-checked every antibody dilution, buffer pH, and transfer time — the bands are still smeared, and I’m now fairly convinced the secondary antibody you left in the shared fridge expired last March, not last June like the label says. I’ve also had to re-prime the gel rig twice because someone keeps borrowing the spacer plates without returning them, and I’m pretty sure that’s the same reason my last two gels leaked. I would have mentioned this earlier, but my scheduled bi-weekly check-in got bumped twice for your grant meeting, so I’m putting it in writing: can we switch to the premade gradient gels, or at least buy fresh antibodies, before I redo the same lane for a fifth time? If not, I’ll just run the negative control tonight and send you the raw film, but please don’t ask me to “troubleshoot it yourself” again — I did, and the problem is the reagents, not my technique.

Dear Office of Technology Transfer,

I am writing to propose a collaborative research pilot between my company, a venture-backed materials science startup, and your Department of Chemical Engineering. Our team has developed a novel membrane coating that reduces fouling in industrial water filtration, and we believe your lab’s recent work on polymer surface chemistry is directly complementary to scaling this technology. We would like to fund a six-month feasibility study, with joint ownership of any resulting intellectual property, using your faculty’s expertise and our proprietary testing equipment. Given your office’s track record of managing industry partnerships, I would be grateful for a brief meeting to discuss potential terms and a project timeline. Please let me know if you are available for a 20-minute call in the coming two weeks.

Zadnjič sem vam poslal ponudbo za avtoklav pa sem dobil nazaj samo auto-reply, da ste “zasedeni”, zdaj pa me že tri tedne ignorirate, čeprav sem vam na glasovno celo pustil podroben načrt dobave – če vas naša oprema ne zanima, mi vsaj povejte, da ne bom izgubljal časa z ljudmi, ki ne znajo odgovoriti na en sam email.

Živjo! Se oglasam iz firme, ki išče lab, k da bi skupi nardil enga projekta za en startup – rabmo neki analize DNK, pa neki vašga strokovnega znanja, tok da me zanima če bi mogl kšn kratek meet čez teden. Mi smo prou prou mali, proračun mamo pa glih tok da pokrijemo material, sam zato bi blo dobr če bi blo kšn interes za publikacijo zraven. Če je kej res, mi dejte vedt pa se zmentava na kavi, lohk tut na vaš teren prdete!

Hi,

I’m reaching out because our team’s archived planetary data from the 1990s is missing the Jupiter atmospheric pressure readings for the months of March and April 1993. Our internal records show we submitted the full year’s files to your institute on June 1st of that year, so I’m wondering if you could check your backup tape archive for that specific batch. If found, a simple PDF scan or even a handwritten table of those two months would be perfect—no need to digitize the whole set.

Thanks for your help.

I’m writing to ask why the collaboration agreement we signed three months ago still hasn’t been countersigned by your legal department—every kickoff meeting we schedule gets delayed because of this, and our team is frankly tired of chasing your office for status updates. Please confirm if there’s an actual blocker, or if we should assume the institute is no longer interested.

Dear Team,

I recently purchased the hand-thrown ceramic pour-over set from your shop and was genuinely impressed by the quality and the thoughtful, plastic-free packaging. As the founder of a small coffee subscription startup, I’m always on the lookout for beautifully crafted accessories to feature in our monthly curation box. Would you be open to a quick chat about a potential wholesale partnership or a one-time cross-promotion for our upcoming fall collection? I’d love to send you a sample of our single-origin beans as a thank you, regardless of your answer. Thank you for your time and for running such a lovely store.

Spoštovani, glede na včerajšnji izbruh neznanega seva v reki Savi vas nujno prosimo, da nam do 14:00 danes posredujete preliminarne rezultate sekvenciranja vzorcev, ki ste jih prejeli iz našega regijskega centra, ter takoj ustavite vse nedovoljene objave podatkov do nadaljnjega uradnega obvestila.

Živjo, čisto sem se izgubil v tvojem zadnjem mailu – pišeš, da rabite 500 kosov, ampak v prilogi je pogodba za 50, in jaz zdaj ne vem, ali sem jaz narobe prebral ali si ti narobe napisal.  
Prosim, razčisti mi to, ker sem že včeraj naročil material za 50, pa če bo treba za 500, bom imel problem z dobaviteljem.

This is the third time I’ve had to write to you about order #47291, which was supposed to arrive last Tuesday via express delivery, but instead your courier left a “missed delivery” note while I was standing in my kitchen with the front door open, and now your customer service line has put me on hold for 47 minutes while the system glitches and refuses to reschedule the drop-off, so either you personally dispatch a driver to my address within the next two hours or I am initiating a chargeback with my bank and posting every screenshot of this nightmare to social media.

This is Jane from Vertex Robotics - we urgently need to adjust our booth demo for Thursday because our lead engineer just discovered a critical firmware bug in the inventory-management system we planned to showcase. Can we secure a 20-minute private slot in the exhibitor lounge to run a revised, cloud-based alternative that still highlights our core value? I know you're slammed, but this is the difference between a successful launch and a costly, public failure for our biggest client. Please reply with any availability between 2 and 5 PM, and I'll send over the updated demo script immediately. Our CEO is waiting on your confirmation before we finalize travel logistics, so time is of the essence.

Spoštovani,

nujno vas moram obvestiti, da smo pri zadnji kontroli kakovosti odkrili napako v seriji 2 mm vezane plošče, ki smo vam jo dobavili prejšnji teden – material ima notranje razpoke, ki niso vidne na prvi pogled, a se bodo zagotovo pokazale pri rezanju z laserjem. Prosimo, da vseh 15 listov, ki jih trenutno hranite v skladišču, nemudoma izločite iz uporabe, saj bi nadaljnja obdelava ogrozila vaše projekte in naše skupne garancijske pogoje. Že danes vam bomo poslali nadomestno pošiljko, ki jo bomo predhodno 100-odstotno pregledali, vendar vas prosimo, da nam s povratnim sporočilom potrdite, da ste serijo označili kot nedostopno. Hkrati vas prosim, da preverite tudi ostale dobave iz zadnjih dveh mesecev, saj sumimo na isto težavo pri enem od naših strojev. Za morebitna vprašanja sem dosegljiv na mobilnem telefonu ves dan, zato vas prosim za hiter odziv.

Dear Team at Lumina Analytics,

I am writing to inquire about the possibility of joining your organization as a part-time data visualization intern for the upcoming spring semester, specifically to support your recent work on real-time consumer sentiment dashboards. Having followed your recent funding announcement and the public release of your retail analytics tool, I am particularly impressed by how your interface translates complex datasets into actionable insights for non-technical users. I am currently a junior majoring in statistics with a minor in computer science, and I have completed coursework in interactive design and R/Python-based visualization, which I believe aligns well with your current project pipeline. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to your team, even on a limited hourly basis, and I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience this month. Thank you for your time and for considering my application.

To Whom It May Concern, I somehow got added to your mailing list and I’m not sure if I accidentally registered for your “Predictive Analytics for Urban Beekeeping” talk, but my neighbor’s goat keeps eating my tent, so can I swap that session for the one about “Emergency Rope Knots” and also does the conference provide a buddy for people who wandered in by mistake?

Dear Team,

I recently came across your platform while researching scalable approaches to automated literature reviews, and I am writing to inquire whether you would be open to a pilot collaboration with my lab’s ongoing meta-analysis on climate adaptation interventions. If feasible, I would like to request a sandbox API key and a technical call with your engineering lead to explore ingestion of our corpus of roughly 4,200 preprints, for which we can offer anonymized gold-standard annotations to help refine your relevance scoring. Your tool appears uniquely suited to the non-linear citation graphs we work with, and I would be glad to sign a standard non-disclosure agreement or data-use addendum at your convenience.

Best regards,  
Dr. Evelyn Hartmann  
Associate Professor, Department of Environmental Informatics  
University of St. Gallen

We’ve been waiting four weeks for the API credentials you promised during onboarding, and your support team has now ignored three separate tickets — meanwhile, your own status page says everything is operational, which is a joke. Either fix the integration by Friday or issue a prorated refund, because I didn’t build my company on vaporware.

Pozdravljeni,

pred tremi tedni sem pri vas naročil sesalnik, ki je bil označen kot “na zalogi”, in plačal po predračunu. Danes, po treh tednih čakanja, pa mi je vaš “prijazni” servis sporočil, da artikla dejansko nimajo več in da mi bodo denar vrnili “v nekaj delovnih dneh”. To pomeni, da sem mesec dni vrtel palce, vi pa ste ves ta čas mirno držali moj denar na svojem računu in se mi niste niti zmenili, dokler nisem sam pisal. 

Takšno poslovanje je pod vsako kritiko in zagotavljam vam, da bom to izkušnjo delil na vseh forumih in družbenih omrežjih, kjer sem član. Še enkrat premislite, kako ravnate s strankami, ker se jezika, ki ga bom uporabil v nadaljevanju, raje prihranim za kakšno drugo priložnost. 

Lep pozdrav,  
Razočarana stranka

Spoštovani organizacijski odbor,

v imenu Študentske sekcije za kognitivno znanost prijavljam prispevek z naslovom »Vpliv dvojezičnosti na izvršilne funkcije pri mladostnikih« za sekcijo nevrolingvistike na letošnji konferenci Mladi raziskujemo možgane. Povzetek obsega 300 besed in temelji na preliminarnih rezultatih pilotne študije, izvedene na 45 udeležencih iz slovenskih dvojezičnih in enojezičnih gimnazij. V kolikor bo prispevek sprejet, bom pripravil tudi kratko predstavitev v obliki posterja, ki bi jo rad predstavil v okviru predvidenega termina petek, 15. novembra. Vljudno vas prosim, da mi sporočite, ali je prijava pravilno prejeta in ali so potrebni še kakšni dodatni dokumenti ali soglasja mentorja. Hvala za vaše razumevanje in trud pri organizaciji dogodka.

Spoštovani,  

pred kratkim sem pri vas naročila sinova šolska copata v velikosti 32, a sta mi po pošti prispeli velikosti 35 – zato vas prosim, če mi lahko sporočite postopek za zamenjavo, saj je sinu druga para premajhna in bi jo rad čim prej nosil.  

Lep pozdrav,  
Maja K.

hey just got my order from u guys and the hoodie i got is like two sizes to small even tho i ordered my usual size, can i swap it for a large or get a refund or somethin? also the zipper on the bag i got is kinda stuck, so if you could sort that out too thatd be great, thanks!

Dear Conference Organizers, I’m writing because my accepted talk “Pigeon-Guided Load Balancing for Microservices” was listed in the program under Session 14B, but the room I was assigned on Friday is actually a broom closet with a live electrical socket, and the projector I was promised is apparently a 1998 VCR that only plays Betamax, so could you please confirm whether I should present to the cleaning staff or if there’s been a mix-up with the parallel tracks on fungal networking?

Dear Team,

We are writing to kindly request that you temporarily pause the sale of your C-31 model carbon monoxide detectors on all online platforms, as they have been found to occasionally fail in detecting low-level leaks during our latest quality assessment, and we would appreciate your cooperation until the issue is resolved to ensure consumer safety.

Please confirm receipt of this message and let us know your estimated timeline for compliance; we are happy to assist with any documentation or clarification needed.

Hi,

We bought your SyncDeck 4-port USB hub last month, and now the second port stops charging unless I wiggle the cable. I need a replacement or a refund—can you send me a prepaid return label and confirm the RMA number within two days?  
Thanks,  
Marta.

Živjo vsi skupaj, torej, glede na to, da smo že kar nekaj časa nazaj govorili o tem, da bi našim praktikantom omogočili bolj poglobljeno sodelovanje pri vaših raziskovalnih projektih, pa sem si čez vikend, ko sem pospravljal garažo in naletel na stare zapiske iz časa mojega študija, mislil, da bi bilo morda res zanimivo, če bi jeseni, ko se začne novi semester in ko bodo naši ljudje že čisto na robu z vsemi roki, organizirali tisto delavnico o terenskem delu, samo da bi mi prej še vedeli, ali imate vi sploh interes in ali bi se dalo to umestiti v vaš učni načrt, ker vem, da imate vi tam svoje postopke, ampak jaz si predstavljam, da bi bilo to nekaj takega kot tisti primer, ko smo lani s tistim študentom rešili problem s podatki, čeprav se je na koncu izkazalo, da je šlo samo za napačen kabel.

Spoštovani, pišem vam, ker bi rada izvedela, ali je možno, da se otroški način na vaši tablici zaklene s štirimestno kodo, in če se da nastaviti, da se po 15 minutah uporabe samodejno izklopi, saj sin zelo rad riše v vaši aplikaciji, a bi mu rada omejila čas pred zaslonom, ne da bi mu morala vsakič vzeti napravo iz rok.

I need you to confirm the revised delivery timeline for the 500 custom PCB units by 9:00 AM tomorrow, because our current stock is already allocated to another client and if your payment doesn't clear by then, we’ll have to reassign the entire batch to them, which will delay your launch by at least three weeks.

Spoštovani,

četrtič zapored vas prosimo, da nam za izstavljeni račun št. 2024/115 pošljete specifikacijo blaga z obrazcem PD-2, pa ga še vedno ni. Vaša “spletna rešitev” za oddajo dokumentov očitno ne deluje, kar nas kot javni organ pošteno utruja.

Če obrazca ne prejmemo v petih delovnih dneh od datuma tega sporočila, bomo primorani sprožiti postopek globe po 39. členu ZPD-1, pa čeprav vemo, da imate na vaši strani vse podatke že od nekdaj.

Lep pozdrav, ampak resnično brez veselja,
Sektor za nadzor javnih naročil

Spoštovani, pišem vam, ker sem na vaši spletni strani videl, da imate laserski rezalnik, ampak ne razumem, zakaj piše, da je “na voljo samo za študente s potrjenim zdravniškim potrdilom o odsotnosti klavstrofobije”, pa tudi, ali je to morda šala ali pa sem zares zamudil kakšen nov varnostni protokol, ker v mojih dvajsetih letih dela z laserji še nikoli nisem slišal za kaj takega, in prosim, če mi lahko poveste, če lahko vseeno dobim dostop za en dan, da bom lahko izrezal nekaj vzorcev za svojo raziskavo o optičnih senzorjih, ki jo moram dokončati do petka, čeprav sem že zdaj čisto zmeden in bi bil zelo hvaležen za vsako pojasnilo.

Spoštovani, najprej naj se vam zahvalim za vašo marljivo prijavo na naš javni razpis, ki smo ga objavili pred dobrima dvema mesecema, čeprav se nam danes že zdi, kot da je minilo večnost, ker smo imeli vmes kar nekaj kadrovskih sprememb in tudi nov informacijski sistem se je obnašal, kot da ga nihče ni testiral, preden so nam ga namestili. Ker pa smo zdaj končno le našli vašo mapo v tistem digitalnem neredu, vas prosimo, da nam v roku desetih delovnih dni vendarle pošljete še enkrat vso zahtevano dokumentacijo, in sicer v dveh izvodih, od tega enega s trdo vezavo, ker tako piše v našem starem pravilniku, ki ga nihče ni posodobil že od leta 1997. Prav tako vas obveščamo, da se je zaradi omenjene reorganizacije spremenil naš poštni naslov, in sicer je zdaj na drugi strani stavbe, dostop pa je samo preko dvorišča, kjer morate počakati, da vam vratar odklene tista rjava vrata z napisom "Dostava samo za overovljene dokumente". Hkrati vas sprašujemo, če bi morda lahko v prihodnje uporabljali izključno pisavo Times New Roman s presledkom 1,5, ker je tako naša glavna referentka vajena brati
